messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The MPON requests a device takeover bid of the MPOO. The MPOO sends a tender for the equipment takeover to the MPON. The MPON places an order at the MPOO. The MPOO confirms the order of the MPON and sends the master data.

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MsgFlow_SendTender" name="Equipment Takeover Tender" sourceRef="Task_MPOO_SendTender" targetRef="Catch_MPON_ReceiveTender" />

    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_MPON_RequestBid" name="Request Device Takeover Bid">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPON_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPON_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Catch_MPON_ReceiveTender" name="Receive Equipment Takeover Tender">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPON_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPON_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_MPON_PlaceOrder" name="Place Order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPON_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPON_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Catch_MPON_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive Order Confirmation and Master Data">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPON_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPON_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPON_4" sourceRef="Task_MPON_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Catch_MPON_ReceiveConfirmation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPON_5" sourceRef="Catch_MPON_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="End_MPON" />
  </bpmn:process>

    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_MPOO_SendTender" name="Send Tender for Equipment Takeover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Catch_MPOO_ReceiveOrder" name="Receive Order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_MPOO_ConfirmAndSendMasterData" name="Confirm Order and Send Master Data">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_4</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_2" sourceRef="Task_MPOO_SendTender" targetRef="Catch_MPOO_ReceiveOrder" />
